content.rendered:
Country Theme Party.

Everyone dressed up in cowboy hats and cowboy boots, line dancing, drinking and having a great birthday party.

Kimberly Branagh
Event: 50th birthday party
Location: Grace street catering
Martin Luther King Jr Way, Oakland, CA 94609
Guests: 100
Date: Saturday, March 15, 2014
Times: 6:00 PM to 11:30 PM
